description: Death with a container open (#233): a client player opens a barrel, picks a hotbar stack onto its cursor in the barrel menu (container_click PICKUP) and dies (/kill at tick 10). Inventory.dropAll throws the inventory; the barrel menu stays open (the barrel counts its viewer) until the client asks to respawn (client_command at tick 20): Player.remove of the dead player closes the menu, the barrel closes and the cursor stack drops.
